notes: The supplied description and page do not specify the model term, emotion/error category, or comparison needed to identify a unique target. No target was assigned from audit ID, input order, or numeric matching. All statistics below are candidates only; none is a row-specific extraction. Accuracy omnibus candidates: TASK F1.4,123.2 = 395.8, p < .001, partial eta squared .822; EMOTION F3.5,298.9 = 107.8, p < .001, partial eta squared .556; TASK × GROUP F2.9,123.2 = 3.1, p = .031, partial eta squared .067; TASK × EMOTION F4.2,361.9 = 92.5, p < .001, partial eta squared .518; TASK × EMOTION × GROUP F8.4,361.9 = 2.6, p = .009, partial eta squared .056 (continues on p.5); GROUP and EMOTION × GROUP collectively Fs ≤ 2.1, ps > .05. The description does not identify a model term; this omnibus model includes all three tasks. Candidate participant counts: the explicitly separate final HC, AN, and MD groups contain 37, 26, and 26 girls. For a three-group critical ANOVA, 37 + 26 + 26 = 89 participants; for AN versus MD, 26 + 26 = 52; for HC versus AN or HC versus MD, 37 + 26 = 63. These are conditional candidate analytic sums, not selected row N values. Medication sensitivity exclusions were nine AN and seven MD participants, but the paper reports findings based on the whole sample. No N was inferred from degrees of freedom. Original fields only were assigned. Replication and reported_success are unassigned placeholders. PDF pages 4–6 rendered and visually inspected; canonical text is the evidence source. No effect-size conversions performed.
